note: Failures the app has today that the commit adding the case does not fix. Each prints on every run and does not fail the run. A known failure that starts passing DOES fail the run, so a fix is never merged without its entry coming off this list. An entry matches a case id exactly through `case`, or by a regular expression through `match` when one finding shows up under several case ids.

failures.shows: Help insights with All languages draws the screen's own language alone: By language lists English alone on an English screen and Espanol alone on a Spanish one, and every tile counts that language's questions only.
failures.why: The Language filter and the language every signed-in call names are one parameter on the address, locale=, and the API reads it as the filter (routes/helpInsights.js readWindow) as well as the answer's language (helpers/language.js). The dashboard cannot leave the language off: every signed-in call names it, and the audit turns away one that does not. The API has to read the filter under a name of its own; the page then sends that name.
failures.where: src/App.js HelpInsightsPage (the query it builds) and withLocale; ocsa-api routes/helpInsights.js readWindow
